name: Pokhara Lakeside Tour

difficulty.notes: Short walks; the boat-and-hike approach to the World Peace Pagoda is a steep 30-40 min stair climb (optional drive around).

duration_days.basis: sightseeing days in Pokhara (hotel to hotel)
duration_days.notes: One full day covers Sarangkot sunrise, Phewa boating, World Peace Pagoda, Davis Falls, Gupteshwor Cave and the International Mountain Museum; a 2nd day allows Begnas Lake, Bindhyabasini Temple, Old Bazaar and adventure add-ons (paragliding, ultralight).

itinerary.route: Pre-dawn drive to Sarangkot for sunrise - Phewa Lake boat to Tal Barahi island temple - boat to south shore and hike to World Peace Pagoda - Davis (Devi's) Falls - Gupteshwor Mahadev Cave
itinerary.notes: Overnight altitude is Phewa Lake surface elevation.

itinerary.route: International Mountain Museum - Seti River Gorge - Bindhyabasini Temple - Old Bazaar - Begnas Lake (optional)

best_seasons.notes: Mountain views (Annapurna, Machhapuchhre, Dhaulagiri) are clearest Oct-Nov and in winter mornings; monsoon (Jun-Sep) often hides peaks. General guidance.

permits.name: Davis (Devi's) Falls entry
permits.fee: NPR 100 per person (another source says NPR 50)

permits.name: Sarangkot viewpoint / viewing tower
permits.fee: Small fee, reported as NPR 60 (tower) or NPR 100

guide_requirements: No legal guide requirement for Pokhara city sightseeing.

logistics.notes: Phewa boats are hired at Lakeside with a boatman.

highlights: Sarangkot (1,592 m) sunrise over the Annapurna range, Machhapuchhre and Dhaulagiri
Phewa Lake (742 m, ~5.7 sq km) with Tal Barahi island temple and Machhapuchhre reflections
World Peace Pagoda (Shanti Stupa, ~1,100 m) on Anadu Hill above the south shore
Davis Falls and Gupteshwor Mahadev Cave
risks: Morning cloud can hide mountain views
Steep stair hike to the Peace Pagoda
unverified: World Peace Pagoda free entry, Davis Falls (NPR 50 vs 100), Gupteshwor Cave (NPR 100) and Sarangkot tower (NPR 60 vs 100) fees come from travel/operator sites only and partly disagree.
Peace Pagoda altitude ~1,100 m is from Wikipedia and travel sites.
